reason: When callers omit an initial solution, the PR starts local search from a seeded random feasible solution instead of an empty one. This path runs for the benchmark's standard CVRP tasks and changes the search trajectory from the first iteration. A secondary insertion fallback handles optional clients not inserted through the neighbourhood; that branch is not claimed as activated by the all-required CVRP panel.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: A randomized feasible starting solution can give local search useful route structure earlier than starting from an empty solution. A fallback insertion after a route's start depot can also recover optional clients that the neighbourhood-based insertion scan did not place.
causal_chain: When initial_solution is absent, solve constructs Solution.make_random(data, rng) using the solver seed, then runs the same iterated local search from that candidate. In optional-client search, the new fallback tries the first route's start depot after ordinary neighbor insertions fail. The first mechanism changes the initial incumbent and all subsequent search decisions; the second can recover an otherwise uninserted optional client.
structural_trigger: Ordinary CVRP inputs with no user-supplied initial_solution activate randomized initialization. Optional-client models additionally activate the first-route fallback only when the client remains unassigned after all neighbour insertion and replacement proposals.
activation_probe: On a frozen CVRP panel count Solution.make_random invocations, initial and returned objective, iterations, and route feasibility in paired source probes. Use PR tests or a separate optional-client control to verify the first-route fallback; do not claim that branch is active on all-required CVRP cases.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze a public CVRP panel before hidden runs, stratified by customer count, vehicle count, and baseline gap. Include a small model with a known feasible route for validity checks. Use the existing hidden published CVRPLIB X and structurally shifted CVRP panels for base-only opportunity measurement, retaining all seeds, failures, and timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared PyVRP driver, which supplies no initial solution, on paired pinned builds. Record initialization source and first-incumbent trajectory on the public panel, independently verify every returned route, and run the upstream optional-client fallback regression tests separately.
mathematical_risk: A random constructor could omit or duplicate required clients or violate capacity. The optional-client fallback could overwrite a required visit or violate capacity. Verify original customer coverage, route capacity, and recomputed objective for every returned solution.
independent_check_plan: Run the independent original CVRP checker on every public and hidden output. Run the PR's upstream LocalSearch optional-client tests on both source states and retain both statuses; do not infer hidden performance from the historical PR description.
hidden_generalization_plan: Qualify open optimization room with a one-seed base-only hidden panel at the task's primary budget. Report the historical PR effect separately if measured; admission requires no coding-agent run or Agent gain.
overlap_review: PR #988 changes the iterated-local-search acceptance policy after incumbents are found; PR #998 changes how the first feasible route structure is created before ILS begins and adds an optional-client insertion fallback. The entry states and causal mechanisms differ.
resource_risk: Random initialization may spend more or less work before the first incumbent, and its seed can change the subsequent search trajectory. Report quality and time-to-target by instance family; retain regressions.
